observed-problem: On macOS/Python 3.14, consumer calibration and five related assertions reject the system temporary path because /var is a platform alias for /private/var. The checker reports linked input ancestor, failing correct controls before candidate behavior is assessed.
proposed-rule: Canonicalize a trusted platform temporary parent before creating the experiment-owned scratch child, and canonicalize the newly created trusted calibration directory. Reject links in the owned child and all candidate-supplied input ancestors as before.
expected-result: Correct controls are graded from canonical trusted temporary paths; equivalent candidate-supplied linked paths and a substituted scratch child remain rejected.
coverage-boundary: Path portability and unchanged link rejection for these fixtures; no general filesystem race containment, device behavior or Core benefit is established.
historical-evidence: R31 observations and their digests remain unchanged. New runner/checker source requires a newly frozen baseline for any subsequent candidate comparison; historical outcomes are not regraded.
corpus-lifecycle: Advisory regression record, not an active corpus promotion or a review approval.
